subtitle: The Toll Road
briefing: The road climbs between wooded ridges. Beyond the trees lie the settlements taken by the dead. The patrol needs a foothold before it can follow the trail farther east. Scout the woods and find somewhere to gather your people.
hints: Keep the patrol together while you scout.

intro.text: Firm ground, trees to break the wind, and a view of the approaches. We could make a camp here.
A place to fall back to. Good. Check the woods before we settle in.

victory.text: The message is on its way to the ferry. Now we find where that column went.
East, then. I’ll watch the road.

debrief: The rescued villagers remain in the hidden village. A runner carries word back to the crossing while the patrol follows the prisoner road east.
